description: This file contains functions to create and configure various vision models (ResNet18, FCN ResNet, DETR) for benchmarking with autograd, including model setup, weight extraction, and loss computation.

methods.name: get_resnet18
methods.description: Creates a ResNet18 model, optionally replaces batch norm modules with functorch, and returns a forward function for loss computation.

methods.name: get_fcn_resnet
methods.description: Creates an FCN ResNet50 model, optionally replaces batch norm modules, disables dropout, and returns a forward function for loss.

methods.name: get_detr
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with specific parameters, replaces batch norm modules if available, and returns a forward function for loss calculation with object detection targets.
